game.romname: World Series of Poker - Tournament of Champions - 2007 Edition (USA)
game.name: World Series of Poker : Tournament of Champions 20 (Europe)
game.desc: World Series of Poker: Tournament of Champions 2007 Edition is broadly divided into three sections: quick games, career mode and multiplayer. You start out in a gloomy basement, before becoming a real carpet killer and making it to the most prestigious tournaments. It's up to you to play, and above all, to bluff in this poker game for Xbox 360.
